sloka: धर्मात्मा सत्यसन्धश्च रामो दाशरथिर्यदि।पौरुषे चाप्रतिद्वन्द्वः शरैनं जहि रावणिम् ।। ६.९१.७२ ।।
transliteration: dharmātmā satyasandhaśca rāmo dāśarathiryadi।pauruṣe cāpratidvandvaḥ śarainaṁ jahi rāvaṇim ।। 6.91.72 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way, Lakshmana, heroic in battle, bending the bow, stretching the arrow till the ear released on Indrajith.
